message.content: {"caption":"Workflow for generating and validating self-questioning tasks from exploration of an environment.","description":"A process diagram shows a sandbox environment described by locations and facilities, together with environment-profile and user-preference inputs, feeding a self-questioning module that produces queries and reference solutions. The workflow has three numbered stages: Exploration, where an agent walks through a map and records a trajectory; Task Synthesis, where the trajectory is considered alongside user preferences such as difficulty, style, and rubrics to propose a problem and reference solution; and Task Curation, where another agent replays the path and filters are applied to check that the query and solution are feasible.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
